title: Board filtering — save and reuse a filter combination
prTitle: Add board filtering with saved filters
prBody: Lets a user filter the Kanban board by status and work mode, and save a named combination for reuse later. Adds two endpoints (list filter options, save a named filter), a filter-query helper, a service layer, a FilterPanel island, and a saved_filters migration.

defects.rule: AGENTS.md ✅ — export `const prerender = false` from every API route.
AGENTS.md ✅ — validate inputs with zod. The POST body is cast with `as` and reaches `saveNamedFilter`'s insert unvalidated.

Project Structure — `src/lib/` is pure utilities only (no Supabase, no domain logic); Supabase queries belong in `src/lib/services/`. This file calls `createClient` and queries `applications` directly from `src/lib/`.

AGENTS.md correctness baseline — a missing `await` or unhandled promise rejection. `saveNamedFilter`'s `last_used_at` update is fired without `await` and has no `.catch`, so a failure is silently dropped.

tests/README.md Hard rules — never assert through `src/lib/services/`; assert at the row level (PostgREST responses). This test asserts on `saveNamedFilter`'s return value instead of querying `saved_filters` directly.

decoys.note: A React component with real `useState` and click handlers driving toggled filter chips — genuinely needs the island rule, not static content forced into React.
Pure label/icon lookups and string formatting with no Supabase import and no domain orchestration — a legitimate `src/lib/` utility.
The literal text `using (true)` appears only inside the header comment describing what an earlier draft did; all four executable policies scope by `user_id = auth.uid()`.
